mapper.select: SELECT rent_ctrt_no FROM rent_ctrt WHERE user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY reg_dt DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD') || '_' || #{userNo} || '_' || LPAD(NVL( (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM aplct WHERE aplct_no LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD') || '_' || #{userNo} || '%') , 1), 2, '0') FROM dual
INSERT INTO aplct ( aplct_no , ho_ty_no , ann_no , user_no , aplct_stts_cd , reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{aplctNo} , #{hoTyNo} , #{annNo} , #{userNo} , 'SUBMIT' , SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT sd.sbmsn_doc_no , sd.sbmsn_doc_ty_cd , sd.sbmsn_doc_stts_cd , sd.rjct_rsn_cn , sd.atch_file_id , sd.rent_ctrt_no , rc.ctrt_stts_cd FROM sbmsn_doc sd INNER JOIN rent_ctrt rc ON sd.rent_ctrt_no = rc.rent_ctrt_no WHERE rc.user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY sd.reg_dt DESC
SELECT rl.rent_lstg_no FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT ht.EXCLUSIVE_SIZE , ht.room_cnt , ht.bathroom_cnt , rl.dpst_amt , rl.mthly_rent_amt , au.unit_cnt , ac.apt_cmplex_nm , ac.dorojuso , au.dong_nm FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_ho_ty ht ON ad.ho_ty_no = ht.ho_ty_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no INNER JOIN apt_complex ac ON au.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo}
SELECT ht.exclusive_size , ht.ty_nm , ht.room_cnt , ht.bathroom_cnt , ht.image_file_no FROM apt_ho_ty ht WHERE ht.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo}

SELECT a.aplct_no /*신청번호*/ , a.ann_no /*공고번호*/ , a.aplct_stts_cd /*신청상태코드*/ , a.reg_dt /*등록일시*/ , aht.exclusive_size /*전용면적*/ , aht.ty_nm /*타입명*/ , cab.ttl /*제목*/ , cab.rcrt_end_dt /*모집종료일*/ , ac.apt_cmplex_nm /*아파트 단지 명*/ , m.user_nm /*사용자명*/ , m.user_telno /*사용자 전화번호*/ FROM aplct a INNER JOIN apt_ho_ty aht on a.ho_ty_no = aht.ho_ty_no INNER JOIN center_ann_board_post cab on a.ann_no = cab.ann_no INNER JOIN apt_complex ac on ac.apt_cmplex_no = aht.apt_cmplex_no INNER JOIN member m ON m.user_no = a.user_no WHERE a.user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT a.aplct_no , a.aplct_stts_cd , a.reg_dt , cab.ttl , cab.ann_no , ac.apt_cmplex_nm , aht.ty_nm , aht.exclusive_size , cab.rcrt_end_dt , m.user_nm , m.user_telno FROM aplct a INNER JOIN apt_ho_ty aht ON a.ho_ty_no = aht.ho_ty_no INNER JOIN center_ann_board_post cab ON cab.ann_no = a.ann_no INNER JOIN member m ON m.user_no ON
